priorFinding: The original examples using не and full-form бы are resolved, but the same conditional-as-actual defect remains for short-form б.

findings.title: Guard the short Russian conditional particle too
findings.reason: The connecting-span and surrounding-predicate guards recognize only бы. Its standard shortened conditional form б still passes the new rejection cue, so the query is routed to history even though it describes conditional rather than actual rejection. As in the original finding, history excludes eligible proposed or hypothetical plans. This is an unhandled form of the same regression introduced by the v10 cue, rather than evidence that the original corpus source is defective.

limitations.reason: The broad particle guard treats nearby не as governing rejection even when it instead governs timing or another constituent. Какой план Ada Marlow не сразу отвергла? ordinarily asks about delayed actual rejection, but returns planning; Не Bo Winters отверг план об осмотре. negates the subject rather than the rejection, and also returns planning. The new не сразу test labels therefore document conservative exclusions, not semantically negated rejection examples. Do not claim the guard preserves every actual rejected-proposal query.

The word-distance and clause-boundary approach remains a precision-oriented cue rather than a discourse parser. Passing a finite probe list does not establish general Russian negation, subject-focus or modality coverage.
